tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Logo colour only (the asterisk mark's tile). Not a UI colour: 2.8:1 on `surface`, so never use it for text or controls.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Interactive colour: primary buttons, active tab text and underline, links, focus ring, calendar icon, storage progress bar. Text in `primary` reads on `surface` (6.4:1) and `surface-dim` (6.1:1).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of primary buttons.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Hover ground of text buttons (Cancel) and icon buttons.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` and `danger-action` fills.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Selected state: active nav pill in the sidebar, Source chips, preset hover in the date picker.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary-container` (13:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, modals, menus and the main content area.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: Sidebar, filter bars, table headers and KPI cards.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Storage Space card in the sidebar.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Hover ground of nav pills and the hamburger button.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Hover ground of clickable table rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: headings, table values, labels on `surface` and `surface-dim` (16:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, filter labels, column headers, inactive tabs, on `surface` and `surface-dim` (9:1).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Hint text, the "—" placeholder and Skip segments. FAILS text contrast (2.5:1 on `surface`): kept exact from the prototype; use only for non-essential hints, never for values.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Strong outline for focused or emphasised borders (4.5:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card, table and modal borders; dividers between rows. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of selects, inputs and the Time Range button. 1.5:1 on `surface`, below the 3:1 for control borders (kept from the prototype); controls also carry a label and `shadow-xs`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Pass values, Data Health, E-Score ≥ 80% badge text and the Optimal pill. Text on `surface` (5:1) and `success-soft`.

tokens.name: success-mark
tokens.usage: Pass line in the trend chart and Pass segment of Execution Steps bars. Marks only (2.3:1, below 3:1: always paired with a legend label).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the "Added to dictionary" badge.

tokens.name: on-success-soft
tokens.usage: Text on `success-soft` (6.5:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Completeness below 90%, the E-Score 70–79% badge and the Monitor pill. As text it is 3.6:1 on `surface` (below 4.5:1, kept from the prototype); pair it with medium weight.

tokens.name: warning-mark
tokens.usage: Missing-column and type-mismatch icons in the Data Dictionary.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: "Found as …" note under a mismatched data type (5.2:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the "Missing" badge.

tokens.name: on-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Text on `warning-soft` (6.4:1).

tokens.name: warning-row
tokens.usage: Ground of a Missing row in the Data Dictionary.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Pencil icon in the Rename modal. Icon only.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the "What changes when you rename" impact box.

tokens.name: caution-border
tokens.usage: Border of the rename impact box.

tokens.name: on-caution-soft
tokens.usage: Text in the rename impact box (8.8:1 on `caution-soft`).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: E-Score below 70%, the Needs Review pill, column header in Investigate Rows, delete warnings. Text on `surface` (6.5:1) and `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: danger-action
tokens.usage: Fill of destructive buttons (Delete permanently, Delete column) with `on-primary` text (4.8:1); Chain Exhausted values above 10%.

tokens.name: danger-mark
tokens.usage: Chain Exhausted line in the chart, Fail segments of Execution Steps, warning icons beside failing rules.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the delete warning box and failed values in Investigate Rows.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Completeness header and chart line, document icons in the product table. As text it is 3.7:1 on `surface` (kept from the prototype); use it for headers and marks, not running text.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the "Not in design" badge.

tokens.name: on-info-soft
tokens.usage: Text on `info-soft` (7.2:1).

tokens.name: info-row
tokens.usage: Ground of a Not-in-design row in the Data Dictionary.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals (0.5 for alert dialogs).

tokens.name: toast
tokens.usage: Toast background, with `on-primary` text.

styles.name: headline-medium
styles.usage: M3 Headline Medium. The E-Score value. One per screen.

styles.name: headline-small
styles.usage: M3 Headline Small, as Drive's page titles ("My Drive") and dialog titles ("Rename"). Page titles, the data product name, modal titles.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: M3 Title Large, as the "Drive" wordmark. The Discovery wordmark beside the logo and KPI values (Rows, Columns, Size, Data Health).

styles.name: title-medium
styles.usage: M3 Title Medium, as Drive's section headings ("Suggested files"). Card and section titles, in sentence case, never uppercase.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: M3 Body Medium / Label Large (500 for labels and buttons), as Drive's file list, nav, chips and menus. Table cells and headers, sidebar, tabs, buttons, filter controls and their labels, menu items, toasts. The default size.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Click on a Data Product to view details
styles.usage: M3 Body Small, as Drive's storage line and tooltips. Supporting text under titles, descriptions, tooltips, the storage line, the E-Score status pill.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: M3 Label Small. Badges, chips, helper text under fields, chart axes and legends. The smallest size.

styles.name: mono-medium
styles.usage: Column names, record counts, dates in the Data Dictionary, values in Top Issues.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Rule names in Execution Steps, data-type badges, the E-Score badge value.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside badges and between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Filter bar gaps; padding inside selects and the Time Range button (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (KPI cards); sidebar gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections; modal padding; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding around the main content.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, small inline controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Toasts and tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Selects, the Time Range button, context menus, nav items for data products.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, filter bars.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Modals and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, nav pills, badges, chips, the E-Score badge.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, buttons and controls: the default elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Context menus, the user menu and toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Modals and dialogs.
